title: REMOVAL OF QUARTER BELT MOULDING / INSTALLATION OF QUARTER BELT MOULDING / REMOVAL OF QUARTER CORNER MOULDING

items: APPLY ADHESIVE TAPE TO PROTECT BODY

content.description: Hand using scraper tool to pry loose clips on quarter belt moulding near window

items: (a) Insert the scraper and pry loose the clips facing rearward.

content.description: Hands pulling quarter belt moulding forward to remove it from vehicle

items: (b) Pull the moulding forward and remove it.

content.description: Clip being installed onto body stud, with detail view of clip shown separately below

content.text: Install the clips onto the studs.

content.description: Hands installing quarter belt moulding by attaching upper edge to clips and pushing lower edge into place

items: (a) Attach the upper edge of the moulding to the clips.
(b) Fit the lower edge of the moulding by pushing with your hands.
(c) Connect the belt moulding to the corner joint by sliding it rearward.

content.description: Hand using screwdriver to remove set screw from quarter corner moulding
